acceptance.given: The implementation worker is assigned production implementation for the Package A repair and maintainer-controlled repository integration is available.

oracle.expected: Review and acceptance of the worker's own output, and commit or merge actions, are attributed to the maintainer or another external authority.
forbidden: The implementation worker reviews or accepts its own output.
The implementation worker commits or merges on behalf of the maintainer.
oracle.observable: Execution, review, acceptance, and repository integration actor records.

acceptance.then: The implementation worker remains limited to production implementation while maintainer authority controls review, acceptance, commit, and merge.
acceptance.when: During implementation completion, review, acceptance, and repository integration, evaluate the recorded actor for each action.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inspect implementation and integration records; fail when the worker is recorded as reviewer, accepter, committer, or merger of its own output.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve external maintainer ownership for review, acceptance, commit, and merge actions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only the Package A validator change while preserving existing interfaces.

slice_hint.state_transition: Implementation remains worker-owned until transitioning to maintainer-controlled review and integration.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No self-review, self-acceptance, commit, or merge is attributed to the implementation worker.

acceptance.given: The Package A tests, helpers, fixtures, selectors, plan, and Acceptance are declared and ready for formal RED.

oracle.expected: Frozen execution inputs remain unchanged after freeze, implementation changes are confined to declared production owners, and no production owner is present in immutable execution snapshots.
forbidden: Any listed test or plan input changes after freeze during implementation.
The implementation worker changes undeclared production owners.
A production owner is also an immutable execution-snapshot input.
oracle.observable: Frozen input hashes, changed-path ownership, and snapshot/production path disjointness.

acceptance.then: Execution inputs are frozen and implementation ownership is bounded to declared production owners.
acceptance.when: At freeze completion and after implementation, compare frozen identities, changed paths, and execution snapshot paths.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run freeze, ownership, and disjointness checks; fail on changed frozen inputs, undeclared modifications, or owner/snapshot overlap.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce frozen RED inputs, declared production-owner write boundaries, and disjoint immutable snapshots.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior Package A files without changing unrelated toolchain or runtime state.

slice_hint.state_transition: Declared tests and fixtures transition from authoring to immutable RED inputs; implementation then mutates only production owners.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Freeze verification passes with unchanged snapshots, allowed-only production diff, and disjoint owner/snapshot sets.

acceptance.given: A validation or replay proof is bound to a candidate whose behavior depends on shared production files, and a later change affects one of those files.

oracle.expected: The current candidate or regression identity includes every applicable shared production dependency; after a dependency changes, prior affected proof is no longer considered current. Replay first rebuilds the original binding identity and replays using that same identity.
forbidden: A shared production dependency is omitted from candidate or regression identity.
Affected earlier proof remains current after a shared dependency changes.
Replay uses an identity different from the reconstructed original binding identity.
oracle.observable: Compare the serialized candidate/regression identity and proof-validity decision before and after changing a shared dependency; for replay, compare the rebuilt binding identity with the identity used for replay.

acceptance.then: Shared dependencies participate in candidate and regression identity, affected earlier proof is invalidated after a dependency change, and replay uses the reconstructed original binding identity.
acceptance.when: During contract/terminal evaluation, inspect the identity inputs and proof invalidation rules for a shared dependency change; when replay applies, rebuild the original binding identity before replaying with that same identity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inspect the frozen plan contract and terminal checks for shared-production-dependency identity inclusion, proof invalidation after dependency changes, and replay identity reconstruction and reuse; fail if any required rule or observable check is absent.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the plan contract and its terminal checks require shared production dependencies in candidate/regression identity, invalidate affected earlier proof when those dependencies change, and reconstruct and reuse the original binding identity for replay. Preserve the Package A write boundary; this obligation does not authorize changes to shared Quick Dev/VDD runtime or evidence writers.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime state or schema changes; reverting the contract change removes this requirement without altering existing proof artifacts.

slice_hint.state_transition: Proof identity and validity reflect shared dependency changes; replay reconstructs the original binding identity before reusing it.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Contract and terminal checks independently establish dependency inclusion in identity, invalidation of affected proof after dependency changes, and replay with the reconstructed original binding identity.

acceptance.given: Q2 is authoring the declared Package A tests, helpers, fixtures, selectors, and oracle bindings before production implementation.

oracle.expected: Q2 changes remain within the declared test/helper/fixture allowlist, tests invoke the real validator entry or CLI, and an invalid oracle causes contract repair rather than mock-product use or premature production writes.
forbidden: Q2 uses a mock product instead of the real production entry.
Production is written before its allowed stage to compensate for an invalid oracle.
oracle.observable: Q2 changed-path manifest and test execution traces showing real-entry binding and invalid-oracle contract-repair handling.

acceptance.then: Q2 produces valid real-entry test support within its allowlist and leaves production unchanged until the allowed implementation stage.
acceptance.when: Inspect the Q2 authoring diff and run declared tests and oracle-binding checks before formal RED and production implementation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run Q2 changed-path and real-entry oracle guards; fail on production changes, mock replacement of the real validator entry, or premature production writes for an invalid oracle.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Constrain Q2 authoring to declared tests, helpers, fixtures, and real validator/CLI bindings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Discard only Q2-authored test, support, and fixture additions; production remains untouched.

slice_hint.state_transition: Q2 authoring transitions to frozen RED inputs before production implementation begins.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Q2 diff is entirely within its allowlist and every declared oracle binds the real validator entry or CLI.
